name: indicator-pair-scatterplots-service
description: Read API of the EUFGIS species distribution map and indicator pair scatterplot panes over the GeoService Scatter* collections: catalogue, base layer, species cells, units, map selection, suitability classes, maps manifest. Requests and answers use the data dictionary's vocabulary (ui_layout_state).
author: Milko Škofič

metadataUi.description: Base URL of the data dictionary's /ui Foxx service (metadata database): used by POST /state/validate and by the health check. The panes read their labels there directly.

maxLevel.description: The highest coordinates-restriction level this instance may answer: gcu_loc_coordinates-restriction_public, _value or _manage. A request asking for more is clamped. Set _public or _value on an instance reachable outside the portal.

lang.description: Fallback language key for the dataset titles and definitions of the catalogue (the only texts this service returns; every label lives in the dictionary).

prefill.description: When true, setup fills the base-layer cache (PanesCache) for every configured pair × climate; about one second each. Otherwise each base answer is computed on its first request and cached.

teardownDropsData.description: When true, teardown also drops the Scatter* data collections this service created. Off by default: a wrong mount or a replace must never erase 250 000 loaded cells. The service's own cache collections are always dropped.
